answer: Force each identity to independently run a fresh, epoch-seeded compute kernel under a tight deadline. One inference pipeline wearing many masks must serialize those kernels, so a swarm of hollow identities stalls the instant they all demand compute at once; their shared latency acts like a pigment that stains every mask the same color, exposing the single mind. Faking N real agents then costs N real machines running in parallel, not one cheap backend, pricing out the one-mind-many-masks sybil.
